policy: Canon Harry Potter names and terms use the official Dutch translation by Wiebe Buddingh' (Zweinstein, Perkamentus, Anderling, Sneep, Dreuzel, Zwerkbal, Griffoendor/Zwadderich/Ravenklauw/Huffelpuf, de Wegisweg, Goudgrijp, Malfidus, Hermelien Griffel, Ron Wemel, Marcel Lubbermans, ...). HPMOR-original names stay as in English (Harry James Potter-Evans-Verres, Michael Verres-Evans, Petunia Evans-Verres, Yermy Wibble, Della, Mr Spoo). Real-world Muggle names, book titles and scientific names stay in English (Feynman Lectures, Gödel, Escher, Bach, Homo erectus); scientific concepts get the standard Dutch term where one exists, otherwise a transparent Dutch coinage. HPMOR-invented magical items and phrases get one fixed Dutch rendering decided here. Dutch typography: titles lowercase before a name (professor Anderling, meneer Potter, madame Mallekin), except 'de Professor' as the narrator's label for Michael. 'Mr~Potter' keeps its tie: 'meneer~Potter'. first_chapter = chapter (1-10) where the term first appears in the source; null = certain to recur later but not yet in chapters 1-10. nl_forms lists plurals, genitives and short forms the translator may use. Use exactly these renderings; if a term is missing, choose, use consistently, and record it in @notes.
